name: Attacking the Mid-Range
summary: Sharpen your in-and-out dribble, hit hop-in jumpers, finish with a long gather, then push your legs with a slide-and-sprint circuit.

drills.name: In-and-Out Rhythm
drills.summary: Sell a crossover with your hand and shoulders, then keep the ball on the same side.
steps: Start in a low stance with the ball in your right hand.
Push the ball toward your left side, then pull it back out with the same hand.
Turn your wrist over the top of the ball on every pull back.
Do 30 seconds per hand, then walk forward doing it.
Finish with an in-and-out into one hard dribble attack each way.

drills.name: Hop-In Mid-Range
drills.summary: Hop into your shot off one dribble so your feet land ready every time.
steps: Start at the top of the key, a step past the three-point line.
Take one hard dribble toward the elbow.
Pick up the ball and hop, landing on both feet at the same time.
Rise straight up and shoot. Hold your follow-through.
Go right elbow, left elbow, then both short corners. Make 5 at each spot.

drills.name: Long Gather Finishes
drills.summary: Use a long last step to get around a defender and finish soft off the glass.
steps: Start at the wing, just inside the three-point line.
Drive hard toward the block with your outside hand.
Gather and take a long last step past an imaginary defender.
Finish high off the glass with the hand farthest from the defender.
Do 5 makes each side, then switch to finishing on the other side of the rim.

drills.name: Slide-Sprint Combo Circuit
drills.summary: Defend, sprint and score while you are tired, just like late in a game.
steps: Set one cone on each block. Put the ball at half court.
Defensive slide from cone to cone and back, twice.
Sprint to half court and pick up the ball.
Speed dribble back and finish with a layup.
Rest 15 seconds, then go again. Keep going until time is up.
